headline: Anthropic wyceniony powyżej widełek. Sztuczna inteligencja działa na inwestorów
summary: Anthropic sold shares in its initial public offering at $83, above the announced range, with the offering valued at more than $81.3 billion, according to Money.pl.
why: Anthropic is a private artificial intelligence developer, and its listing is a key test of investor demand for AI companies.
why_moved: Pricing above the announced range was cited as evidence of strong investor demand for artificial intelligence investments.
